answer: Rotating Challenge Seeding: each identity must solve a fresh, randomly generated challenge derived from live environmental telemetry (a glacier sensor reading, a meadow soil probe, a plume height sample). Answers are valid only once and expire within minutes, so copying a solved answer fails verification. To precompute ahead, an attacker must physically field sensors per identity, paying hardware and maintenance costs per sybil—roughly one sensor kit each, every cycle.
